svg.text: How FVF + DFC + SRE Solve the Capless Paradox

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Without external 1 µF cap, ω_out = 1/(R_out·Cout) sits at MHz right near

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ω_gate = 1/(R_buf·Cgg) -> classic 2-stage Miller LDO oscillates violently!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • FVF Local Loop lowers pass-gate drive R_buf by local gain, pushing ω_gate high.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Dynamic SRE: C_SRE·(dVout/dt) fires momentary mA current spike onto V_G,PASS

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: only during fast load edges, achieving ns recovery at µA quiescent I_Q!
